title: Humor en la educación, protagonistas, valoraciones favorables de siempre y nuevas impresiones Humor in Education: Key Actors, Longstanding Positive Assessments, and New Perspectives Humor na educação: protagonistas, avaliações favoráveis de longa data e novas percepções L’humour dans l’éducation : protagonistes, appréciations favorables de longue date et nouvelles perceptions
text_snippet: Humor en la educación, protagonistas, valoraciones favorables de siempre y nuevas impresiones Humor in Education: Key Actors, Longstanding Positive Assessments, and New Perspectives Humor na educação: protagonistas, avaliações favoráveis de longa data e novas percepções L’humour dans l’éducation : protagonistes, appréciations favorables de longue date et nouvelles perceptions Increasingly, affective aspects, and in particular humor, appear on the theoretical and practical horizon of education. The objective of this research is to examine and analyze the use of humor in the teaching-learning process. To this end, a general review of concepts and approaches to humor and its role in education is conducted. A case study is also conducted through participation in a university focus group in 2024, focused on the topic. As a finding, humor is favorably valued, its use is moderate in this higher education institution, and mainly benefits are noted, as well as some disadvantages. The conclusion is the desire for its widespread and generalized use in the classroom and university life, among other issues, which reveal certain experiences and new sensibilities on the subject.

It adopts a theoretical and conceptual approach supported by a documentary review and analysis of recent empirical cases. The proposed model articulates five dimensions: transformative leadership, educational justice, community participation, institutional ethics, and pedagogical articulation. Its limitations include the need for empirical validation and structural conditions for its implementation. The proposal adds value by critically discussing the prevailing technocratic frameworks and offers an alternative with contextual relevance and formative potential. It concludes that school management cannot be understood as a technical function, but rather as a political, pedagogical, and relational practice. title: Educar bajo el fuego cruzado Teaching Under Crossfire Éduquer sous des juridictions croisées Educar sob jurisdições cruzadas
text_snippet: Educar bajo el fuego cruzado Teaching Under Crossfire Éduquer sous des juridictions croisées Educar sob jurisdições cruzadas Ser maestro en los márgenes (2024) de Alberto Colin Huizar como una obra clave de antropología comprometida. El libro, derivado de una tesis premiada (Cátedra Jorge Alonso 2023 y Academia Mexicana de Ciencias 2024), analiza mediante etnografía densa cómo la violencia criminal en la Tierra Caliente de Michoacán (Valle de Apatzingán, Aguililla, Tepalcatepec) transformó la escuela en nodo de guerra desde 2006. Huizar muestra que la militarización estatal agravó la precariedad docente: extorsiones, desplazamientos, asesinatos y reclutamiento forzado de alumnos. Lejos de victimizarse, los maestros (principalmente CNTE-Sección XVIII) desarrollan estrategias de resistencia: rutas seguras, clases clandestinas y negociación con cárteles. Apoyado en “márgenes del Estado” y “continuum de violencias”, el texto humaniza sin sensacionalismo, compara con Colombia, Guatemala y Perú, y cuestiona la narrativa oficial de pacificación. Lectura imprescindible para entender la escuela pública mexicana como espacio de disputa política y resistencia radical.

Financiamento, cobertura e equidade educacional na América Latina (2015-2025) El objetivo de este artículo es describir la evolución reciente del financiamiento público, la gestión de la cobertura y los aprendizajes en la educación secundaria baja en América Latina, considerando el rol de este nivel como base para la equidad educativa. Se adopta un enfoque longitudinal descriptivo que reúne información oficial sobre gasto educativo y cobertura, junto con los resultados de tres rondas comparables de PISA (2015, 2018 y 2022) para seis países de la región con participación continua. Los hallazgos muestran avances en acceso y finalización, pero estancamiento o disminución del gasto real por estudiante y brechas socioeconómicas persistentes en los aprendizajes.

title: Educación ambiental para el cambio climático en la gestión institucional Environmental Education for Climate Change in Institutional Management Éducation environnementale au changement climatique dans la gestion institutionnelle Educação ambiental para as mudanças climáticas na gestão institucional
text_snippet: Educación ambiental para el cambio climático en la gestión institucional Environmental Education for Climate Change in Institutional Management Éducation environnementale au changement climatique dans la gestion institutionnelle Educação ambiental para as mudanças climáticas na gestão institucional El cambio climático constituye uno de los desafíos más significativos para la humanidad, y ante el cual las instituciones de educación superior deben de plantearse una gestión institucional orientada al cambio climático que propicie la formación científica y crítica de los estudiantes. El artículo tiene el objetivo de plantear una propuesta de integración de la educación para el cambio climático en la gestión institucional, a partir de la recuperación y análisis de algunos de los principales documentos elaborados por organismos internacionales y el Gobierno de México, así como de los resultados de varias investigaciones realizadas con estudiantes universitarios. A partir de este análisis se considera que la gestión institucional puede impulsar una cultura ambiental, que vaya más allá de los cambios curriculares y que la educación para el cambio climático contribuye en la formación de comunidades estudiantiles competentes para reflexionar y actuar en escenarios de incertidumbre.

text_snippet: Análisis sistemático de la educación inicial en México: una revisión de alcance basada en PRISMA (2019-2025) Systematic Analysis of Early Childhood Education in Mexico: A PRISMA-Based Scoping Review (2019–2025) Análise sistemática da educação infantil no México: uma revisão de escopo baseada no PRISMA (2019-2025) Analyse systématique de l’éducation de la petite enfance au Mexique : une revue de la portée basée sur PRISMA (2019-2025) The objective of this study is to analyze the scientific production on Early Childhood Education in Mexico, focusing on the tensions between public policy, teacher training, and educational practices. A systematic literature review (2019–2025) was conducted according to the PRISMA guidelines. The results show a persistent gap between regulatory design and its implementation, linked to the diversity in the training of educational agents, institutional conditions, and the persistence of welfare-based approaches. Progress in the recognition of Early Childhood Education as part of basic education was also noted, along with challenges to its professional consolidation. The study concludes that it is necessary to strengthen the interplay among public policy, teacher training, and curriculum development to ensure quality Early Childhood Education through a comprehensive, rights-based approach.

title: Inteligencia artificial en la educación latinoamericana Artificial Intelligence in Latin American Education Inteligência artificial na educação latino-americana L' intelligence artificielle dans l’éducation en Amérique latine
text_snippet: Inteligencia artificial en la educación latinoamericana Artificial Intelligence in Latin American Education Inteligência artificial na educação latino-americana L' intelligence artificielle dans l’éducation en Amérique latine A systematic conceptual review critically analyzed the state of the art regarding artificial intelligence in Latin American education and its relationship to educational equity. Of the 59 articles indexed in Scopus (2024–2025), 14 were selected for in-depth analysis using Latin American educational justice frameworks. Three paradoxes were identified: personalization versus algorithmic standardization; innovation versus widening gaps in access, use, and design; and empowerment versus technological coloniality. Only 11.9% of the articles addressed equity or inequality, excluding vulnerable populations such as Indigenous peoples or migrants. This is the first regional systematization since ChatGPT that articulates educational AI and social justice. The study concludes that AI can amplify inequalities without inclusive policies, critical literacy, and participatory ethical regulation.

This article analyzes critical digital citizenship through Habermas's theory of communicative action and proposes pedagogical devices that foster ethical reflection, deliberation, and democratic participation. It argues that digital civic education cannot be limited to technical competencies; it must include the capacity to question technopolitical frameworks, recognize algorithmic biases, and confront misinformation. The proposed devices aim to strengthen agency, argumentation, and ethical judgment in digital environments: deliberative forums, critical platform analysis, digital deliberation labs, pedagogical-ethical use of AI, and action-research projects. title: Inteligencia artificial generativa en educación Generative Artificial Intelligence in Education Inteligência artificial generativa na educação L' intelligence artificielle générative en éducation
text_snippet: Inteligencia artificial generativa en educación Generative Artificial Intelligence in Education Inteligência artificial generativa na educação L' intelligence artificielle générative en éducation The article aimed to identify trends in Spanish-language academic production on Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in education. A scoping literature review was conducted following the PRISMA protocol. Scopus and SciELO databases were used, selecting 79 relevant articles published between 2022 and February 2025. The results reveal that the trend in Spanish-language literature on GAI can be grouped around systematic reviews, reflection articles, user perspectives, and reports of specific applications. The tool's potential in the educational field is highlighted, although risks and concerns are noted. While the identified themes converge with global discussions, the lower presence of studies in Spanish may hinder the incorporation of this technology in the Latin American region. The conclusions underscore the importance of epistemic sovereignty and the urgency of generating contextualized knowledge in the area through research and formation.

title: Inteligencia artificial en la educación: entre la equidad digital y la exclusión algorítmica Artificial Intelligence in Education: Between Digital Equity and Algorithmic Exclusion Inteligência artificial na educação: entre a equidade digital e a exclusão algorítmica L' intelligence artificielle dans l'éducation : entre l'équité numérique et l'exclusion algorithmique
text_snippet: Inteligencia artificial en la educación: entre la equidad digital y la exclusión algorítmica Artificial Intelligence in Education: Between Digital Equity and Algorithmic Exclusion Inteligência artificial na educação: entre a equidade digital e a exclusão algorítmica L' intelligence artificielle dans l'éducation : entre l'équité numérique et l'exclusion algorithmique The article critically analyzes the relationship among inequality, education, and justice in the context of the use of artificial intelligence in education. Based on a conceptual theoretical analysis from hermeneutics, the risks and tensions associated with implementing this new technology in contexts marked by inequality are established. The findings show that it is not a neutral resource and can reproduce existing gaps if it is not implemented in an ethical and contextualized way. In this documentary research, three axes of reflection are articulated: distributive justice, technological capital, and critical epistemologies. It is concluded that it is imperative to guarantee equitable access and to train in critical subjects related to technological systems. This discussion is a contribution to current debates on digital equity and education in the age of automation.

text_snippet: De facilitadores a mediadores críticos: el impacto de la IAGen en la enseñanza universitaria From Facilitators to Critical Mediators: The Impact of Generative AI on University Teaching Des facilitateurs aux médiateurs critiques : l’impact de l’IA générative sur l’enseignement universitaire De facilitadores a mediadores críticos: o impacto da IA generativa no ensino universitário Objective: This study examines how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is reshaping the role of university faculty from a critical, sociotechnical perspective. Design/Methodology: A qualitative approach was used, drawing on semi-structured interviews with 19 dentistry professors at a Mexican public university. Thematic analysis with ATLAS.ti Web organized findings into three areas: faculty perceptions, pedagogical practices, and institutional conditions. Findings and limitations: Participants saw GenAI’s potential to enrich teaching but highlighted risks to pedagogy and student learning. The adoption of technology is situated and determined by unequal institutional conditions that mediate its effectiveness. The study focused on one discipline which limits generalizations.

title: La inteligencia artificial generativa en la educación superior Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education Inteligência artificial generativa no ensino superior L' intelligence artificielle générative dans l’enseignement
text_snippet: La inteligencia artificial generativa en la educación superior Generative Artificial Intelligence in Higher Education Inteligência artificial generativa no ensino superior L' intelligence artificielle générative dans l’enseignement This study examines the ethical challenges of using Generative Artificial Intelligence in higher education through a systematic review of Ibero-American literature (2023–2024) following PRISMA guidelines. A search of various databases yielded a corpus of nine articles. The analysis, based on MAXQDA 2024, was structured around five categories: academic integrity, critical reflection, responsible use, gaps and equity of access, and institutional conditions. The results reveal consensus on the need for ethical and pedagogically purposeful use, but also gaps and tensions regarding integrity, equity, regulation, and teacher training. The study concludes that the urgent need for comprehensive regulatory frameworks and AI literacy training must be addressed within the Ibero-American context.

title: Generative AI in Teaching Practices: Perspectives of Mexican English Teachers IA generativa en la práctica docente: perspectivas de profesores mexicanos de inglés Inteligência artificial generativa na prática docente: perspectivas de professores de inglês mexicanos L' intelligence artificielle générative dans la pratique pédagogique : perspectives des professeurs d’anglais mexicains
text_snippet: Generative AI in Teaching Practices: Perspectives of Mexican English Teachers IA generativa en la práctica docente: perspectivas de profesores mexicanos de inglés Inteligência artificial generativa na prática docente: perspectivas de professores de inglês mexicanos L' intelligence artificielle générative dans la pratique pédagogique : perspectives des professeurs d’anglais mexicains This study evaluated the impact of a multi-phase educational intervention designed to foster the learning and use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in creating educational resources for teaching English as a foreign language (EFL). Fifteen students from a master's program in English language teaching at a Mexican public university participated. The intervention was evaluated using a qualitative approach, with a preliminary assessment and a reflective thematic analysis of discussions in two online forums. The results revealed a positive transformation in participants' knowledge of GAI, their ability to integrate it into their teaching practices, and an increase in their confidence in and adoption of GAI to create innovative teaching materials. This suggests the potential of structured educational interventions to empower future English teachers with advanced digital skills.

title: Educación en la era de la inteligencia artificial generativa: desafíos éticos y filosóficos Education in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Ethical and Philosophical Challenges L' éducation à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle générative : enjeux éthiques et philosophiques Educação na Era da Inteligência Artificial Generativa: Desafios Éticos e Filosóficos
text_snippet: Educación en la era de la inteligencia artificial generativa: desafíos éticos y filosóficos Education in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Ethical and Philosophical Challenges L' éducation à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle générative : enjeux éthiques et philosophiques Educação na Era da Inteligência Artificial Generativa: Desafios Éticos e Filosóficos En esta serie de entrevistas en video, realizadas en 2024 con ocho académicos mexicanos, se presentan sus perspectivas, técnicas, críticas y enfoques educativos sobre la noción de inteligencia artificial (IA). El diálogo nos permite ubicar los orígenes de la IA en el campo de la cibernética y su curso por periodos de auge, pero también de desencuentro, referidos como inviernos. El boom contemporáneo del campo de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa se explica por los avances en el entrenamiento de grandes modelos de lenguaje, por un poder de cómputo sin precedentes y por el acceso a grandes volúmenes de datos en línea. En las entrevistas se abordan las implicaciones filosóficas relativas a la autoría, la creatividad, la veracidad de la información y los desafíos que se generan al delegar la autoridad en el algoritmo, así como sus implicaciones en el contexto educativo.

text_snippet: Percepciones de docentes universitarios sobre la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en los procesos de enseñanza y aprendizaje University Faculty Perceptions of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Teaching and Learning Processes Percepções de docentes universitários sobre a Inteligência Artificial Generativa nos processos de ensino e aprendizagem Perceptions des enseignants universitaires sur l'Intelligence Artificielle Générative dans les processus d'enseignement et d'apprentissage Perceptions des enseignants universitaires sur l’Intelligence artificielle générative dans les processus d’enseignement et d’apprentissage This study examines university teachers' perceptions of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in teaching and learning processes, analyzing how it permeates their instructional practice. A qualitative methodology was implemented using a survey with open and closed questions applied to 30 university teachers. The results reveal both favorable aspects and challenges regarding its classroom implementation. It is concluded that the emergence of GAI has created tension around learning, prompting questions about its role in teaching and learning, since in some cases it may constitute a pedagogical obstacle for teachers, as it introduces new realities into these processes.

title: Asesoría en ciencias experimentales: usos de la Inteligencia Artificial por docentes de Centros PILARES en la Ciudad de México Consulting in experimental sciences: Uses of Artificial Intelligence by teachers from PILARES Centers in Mexico City Consultoria em ciências experimentais: Usos da Inteligência Artificial por professores dos Centros PILARES na Cidade do México Conseil en sciences expérimentales : L’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle par les enseignants des centres PILARES de Mexico
text_snippet: Asesoría en ciencias experimentales: usos de la Inteligencia Artificial por docentes de Centros PILARES en la Ciudad de México Consulting in experimental sciences: Uses of Artificial Intelligence by teachers from PILARES Centers in Mexico City Consultoria em ciências experimentais: Usos da Inteligência Artificial por professores dos Centros PILARES na Cidade do México Conseil en sciences expérimentales : L’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle par les enseignants des centres PILARES de Mexico Artificial intelligence (AI) has impacted various aspects of daily life, including education. The objective of this study is to identify and describe the perceptions, uses, and AI tools employed by teachers at the Innovation, Freedom, Art, Education, and Knowledge Hubs (PILARES) in Mexico City (CDMX) to advise students enrolled in the Public Education Secretariat's (SEP) online high school program taking experimental science modules. A quantitative, descriptive-analytical methodology was used, employing a digital survey administered to 325 teachers. The results show predominantly positive perceptions, particularly regarding the speed of information retrieval and activity development; however, the teachers warn that indiscriminate use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) can lead to unethical practices, superficial learning, and a weakening of critical thinking.

title: Tensiones entre asistencia y reemplazo: autoetnografía docente de la IA generativa en la educación superior Tensions entre assistance et remplacement : une autoethnographie enseignante de l’IA générative dans l’enseignement supérieur Tensões entre assistência e substituição: autoetnografia docente da IA generativa na educação superior
text_snippet: Tensiones entre asistencia y reemplazo: autoetnografía docente de la IA generativa en la educación superior Tensions entre assistance et remplacement : une autoethnographie enseignante de l’IA générative dans l’enseignement supérieur Tensões entre assistência e substituição: autoetnografia docente da IA generativa na educação superior This article examines, through a year-long teaching autoethnography in two Mexico City universities, the integration of generative artificial intelligence in higher education, comparing face-to-face and distance modalities. Using a field diary that separated and brought into dialogue the roles of teacher and researcher, followed by thematic analysis, we identified emerging practices, tensions, and opportunities. Findings show widespread yet concealed uses, fueled by stigma and punitive approaches; in distance education there is a stronger tendency toward undeclared use, whereas opening spaces for dialogue fostered ethical, creative, and reflective appropriation by the end of the course. The contribution lies in a situated, introspective view of the integration process and in mapping opportunities to strengthen the agency and decision-making of both students and instructors.

text_snippet: Uso de la IAG para apoyar la enseñanza de Educadores Comunitarios del Conafe en Oaxaca Using Generative AI to Support the Teaching of Conafe Community Educators in Oaxaca Uso da IAG para apoiar a formação de educadores comunitários na CONAFE em Oaxaca Utilisation de l'IAG pour la formation des animateurs communautaires à CONAFE Oaxaca This article documents the process developed by Conafe Oaxaca to explore the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in ways that are relevant to its educational model and rural contexts, and to identify implications for the professional development of Community Educators (EC). The study systematizes evidence from a “Task Team” composed of Community Educators for Regional Support (ECAR) and Academic Coordinators (CA) who experimented with various GenAI tools. Perceptions regarding benefits, risks, and conditions required for educational use were explored through semi-structured interviews. The results highlight the importance of providing training and mentoring processes that lead to the critical appropriation of GenAI, to develop digital competencies (technical and ethical) that respond to community needs, grounded in recognition of the EC’s experience and professional agency, and aligned with the Conafe educational model.

title: El diálogo docente-IA: análisis de los perfiles de interacción con Inteligencia Artificial Generativa The Teacher-AI Dialogue: Analysis of Interaction Profiles with Generative Artificial Intelligence O diálogo docente-IA: análise dos perfis de interação com Inteligência Artificial Generativa Le dialogue enseignant-IA : analyse des profils d'interaction avec l'Intelligence Artificielle Générative
text_snippet: El diálogo docente-IA: análisis de los perfiles de interacción con Inteligencia Artificial Generativa The Teacher-AI Dialogue: Analysis of Interaction Profiles with Generative Artificial Intelligence O diálogo docente-IA: análise dos perfis de interação com Inteligência Artificial Generativa Le dialogue enseignant-IA : analyse des profils d'interaction avec l'Intelligence Artificielle Générative This study analyzed the nature of dialogue between teachers and Generative Artificial Intelligence in educational contexts, based on 7,340 anonymized conversations from the comenio.ai platform. An analytical framework was inductively developed and applied at scale using a large language model (LLM). Subsequently, K-means clustering and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) were employed to identify patterns of use. The results revealed three main profiles: (1) Instrumental–Transactional (50.7%), oriented towards optimizing tasks and processes; (2) Pedagogical Co-designer (29.2%), focused on generating complex learning experiences; and (3) Reactive Repair Dialogue (20.1%), characterized by iterative interactions aimed at correcting AI limitations. The study provides an empirically grounded typology of teacher–AI dialogue, along with a conceptual and methodological framework to guide future research and the design of teacher professional development programs for the strategic use of generati

title: Algoritmos de aprendizaje automático aplicados en analíticas de aprendizaje en la Educación Superior Machine Learning Algorithms Applied in Learning Analytics in Higher Education Algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina aplicados em analíticas de aprendizagem no ensino superior
text_snippet: Algoritmos de aprendizaje automático aplicados en analíticas de aprendizaje en la Educación Superior Machine Learning Algorithms Applied in Learning Analytics in Higher Education Algoritmos de aprendizado de máquina aplicados em analíticas de aprendizagem no ensino superior The incorporation of artificial intelligence in higher education has opened up new possibilities for optimizing teaching and learning processes. In this context, machine learning is positioned as a key tool for enhancing learning analytics, enabling the prediction of student dropout rates, personalizing content, and supporting pedagogical and administrative decision-making. This article presents a review of recent studies that integrate machine learning algorithms in university contexts. The algorithms used are identified and classified, with their uses, advantages, and limitations highlighted by study type. The findings guide selecting algorithms based on specific research or educational intervention objectives. It is concluded that significant gaps remain in the literature, underscoring the need for more in-depth, applied research in this emerging field.

title: Análisis de trayectorias estudiantiles mediante distribuciones de fase discretas acíclicas Student Trajectory Analysis Using Acyclic Discrete Phase-type Distributions Analyse des Trajectoires Étudiantes à l'aide de Distributions de Phase Discrètes Acycliques Análise de Trajetórias Estudantis por meio de Distribuições de Fase Discretas Acíclicas
text_snippet: Análisis de trayectorias estudiantiles mediante distribuciones de fase discretas acíclicas Student Trajectory Analysis Using Acyclic Discrete Phase-type Distributions Analyse des Trajectoires Étudiantes à l'aide de Distributions de Phase Discrètes Acycliques Análise de Trajetórias Estudantis por meio de Distribuições de Fase Discretas Acíclicas In this work, we analyzed student trajectories using mixtures of acyclic discrete phase-type distributions. The methodology introduced in this paper provides a novel approach to modeling student trajectories. The proposed mixture model consists of a discrete Coxian distribution to estimate dropout probabilities in the initial semesters of academic programs and a generalized negative binomial distribution to estimate graduation probabilities. Both components are discrete phase-type distributed, yielding a new discrete phase-type random variable that provides a detailed probabilistic framework for understanding student transitions and outcomes. To calibrate our proposed model, we used a hypothetical example; subsequently, we applied it to real data from a mathematics program. Our approach not only identifies critical periods for potential interventions but also offers a flexible framework applicable to diverse educational contexts. The insights gained from our model can guide educational institutions in developing targeted strategies to en

title: Transformación de las interacciones educativas universitarias a partir del uso de inteligencia artificial generativa Transformação das interações educativas universitárias a partir do uso de inteligência artificial generativa Transformation des interactions éducatives universitaires à partir de l’usage de l’intelligence artificielle générative
text_snippet: Transformación de las interacciones educativas universitarias a partir del uso de inteligencia artificial generativa Transformação das interações educativas universitárias a partir do uso de inteligência artificial generativa Transformation des interactions éducatives universitaires à partir de l’usage de l’intelligence artificielle générative In recent years, generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has shown both benefits and risks in education and has increasingly provided educational support by simulating language and emotions. This study examines the interactions established by university students with the GenAI tool ChatGPT, focusing on dialogic exchanges, prompts, and the roles assigned - factors that may contribute to its humanization. Using a concurrent mixed-methods design, a qualitative analysis was conducted on the content of prompts and narratives regarding experiences and emotions related to GenAI use, alongside a K-means analysis of Likert-type items concerning kinds of interactions and attributed roles. The findings reveal a dichotomous stance: while some students perceive ChatGPT as an educational agent with whom they engage in interactions comparable to or even superior to those with their teachers, others primarily regard it as a functional tool that facilitates academic tasks without necessarily attributing to it an emotional or interpersonal role.

title: La identidad docente de los profesores de educación media superior. El caso del colegio de bachilleres de Chiapas Teaching identity in high school teachers. The case of the Colegio de bachilleres of Chiapas
text_snippet: La identidad docente de los profesores de educación media superior. El caso del colegio de bachilleres de Chiapas Teaching identity in high school teachers. The case of the Colegio de bachilleres of Chiapas It is presented data, obtained of the research called “the identity teaching of the teachers of the school of bachilleres of Chiapas”. This article analyses and discusses the reasons why teachers have chosen to enter and continue in the teaching profession, as well as the degree of motivation to perform, some ideas about this profession and its current training needs. An exploratory quantitative study was done, with cross design and implemented a sampling non-probability of intentional kind. The results obtained are based on the application of a survey adapted to teachers of high school level, It allowed us recover information about their conceptions which make us display and interpret how their identity is built as a collaborated workers of teaching, constantly exposed by changes in the education policy, social phenomena and, technologic development.

Los hallazgos muestran una colaboración continua con comunidades originarias del Estado de México, la adopción de metodologías participativas, generalmente de tipo cualitativo, y la integración de lenguas indígenas en distintos niveles. title: El camino de las escuelas normales hacia la educación superior. Una mirada desde la evaluación The Path of Normal Schools toward Higher Education: A Perspective from Evaluation O caminho das escolas normais rumo ao ensino superior: Um olhar a partir da avaliação Le parcours des écoles normales vers l'enseignement supérieur : Un regard à partir de l'évaluation
text_snippet: El camino de las escuelas normales hacia la educación superior. Una mirada desde la evaluación The Path of Normal Schools toward Higher Education: A Perspective from Evaluation O caminho das escolas normais rumo ao ensino superior: Um olhar a partir da avaliação Le parcours des écoles normales vers l'enseignement supérieur : Un regard à partir de l'évaluation With the objective of understanding the successes and obstacles that the federal educational authority has faced in enabling normal schools to function as higher education institutions, this inquiry draws upon external evaluations that have been conducted on this topic, as well as testimonies from officials responsible for these policies. The research is carried out through a case study in which the information retrieval techniques are document analysis and semi-structured interviews. The results show the transformation of the normal education system, although there are still limitations related to budget execution, the training of its students, the admission and promotion profiles of teacher educators, as well as the reluctance of state authorities to organizationally position them within higher education. A pending matter that requires attention is the evaluation of the impact of these programs.

title: Desafíos y necesidades en la formación inicial de docentes multigrado en México: hacia un modelo pertinente para contextos rurales Challenges and Needs in Pre-service Training for Multigrade Teachers in Mexico: Toward a Relevant Model for Rural Contexts Desafios e necessidades na formação inicial de docentes multisseriados no México: rumo a um modelo pertinente para contextos rurais Défis et besoins dans la formation initiale des enseignants multigrades au Mexique : vers un modèle pertinent pour les contextes ruraux
text_snippet: Desafíos y necesidades en la formación inicial de docentes multigrado en México: hacia un modelo pertinente para contextos rurales Challenges and Needs in Pre-service Training for Multigrade Teachers in Mexico: Toward a Relevant Model for Rural Contexts Desafios e necessidades na formação inicial de docentes multisseriados no México: rumo a um modelo pertinente para contextos rurais Défis et besoins dans la formation initiale des enseignants multigrades au Mexique : vers un modèle pertinent pour les contextes ruraux In Mexico, more than one-third of all elementary education schools operate under the multigrade modality. It is necessary to develop curriculum designs that provide elements for teachers to improve their performance when providing educational services in this modality. One alternative is to recover experiences and knowledge from in-service teachers as a source for curriculum design. This exploratory cross-sectional study aims to identify the topics that, from the perspective of multigrade school teachers, should be included in initial teacher training processes. To achieve this purpose, in 2020 a survey was administered to 3,002 teachers from different states. The results show three groups of topics considered essential for training in multigrade contexts: teaching practice, curriculum and scientific and technical knowledge; school management; and student and contex

title: Desde la inclusión como política de acceso hacia una perspectiva curricular subjetiva: umbral para una ética de la Interpelación From inclusion as an access policy to a subjective curricular perspective: a theoretical proposal from the threshold for an ethics of Interpellation Da inclusão como política de acesso para uma perspectiva curricular subjetiva: proposta teórica a partir do limiar para uma ética da Interpelação De l'inclusion comme politique d'accès vers une perspective curriculaire subjective : proposition théorique depuis le seuil pour une éthique de l'Interpellation
text_snippet: Desde la inclusión como política de acceso hacia una perspectiva curricular subjetiva: umbral para una ética de la Interpelación From inclusion as an access policy to a subjective curricular perspective: a theoretical proposal from the threshold for an ethics of Interpellation Da inclusão como política de acesso para uma perspectiva curricular subjetiva: proposta teórica a partir do limiar para uma ética da Interpelação De l'inclusion comme politique d'accès vers une perspective curriculaire subjective : proposition théorique depuis le seuil pour une éthique de l'Interpellation This essay proposes a critical rereading of educational inclusion in Initial Teacher Education (ITE), moving away from conceptions centered on access and coverage, to understand it as an ethical and relational experience. From a phenomenological-hermeneutic approach, curricular intersubjectivity is explored as the core from which the formative trajectories of both pre-service teachers and academic faculty are configured. Based on a critique of curricular homogenization and the logic of performativity, the text argues that educating from difference implies decentering the curriculum and opening it to the voices, memories, and bodies that have been historically marginalized. It is concluded that true inclusion is not decreed, but rather practiced as a way of being-with, where ethics, listening, and mutual

title: Formación antropológica y socioemocional: efectos en la inteligencia emocional percibida del profesorado Anthropological and socio-emotional training: effects on teachers' perceived emotional intelligence Formação antropológica e socioemocional: efeitos na inteligência emocional percebida do professorado Formation anthropologique et socioémotionnelle : effets sur l'intelligence émotionnelle perçue du personnel enseignant
text_snippet: Formación antropológica y socioemocional: efectos en la inteligencia emocional percibida del profesorado Anthropological and socio-emotional training: effects on teachers' perceived emotional intelligence Formação antropológica e socioemocional: efeitos na inteligência emocional percebida do professorado Formation anthropologique et socioémotionnelle : effets sur l'intelligence émotionnelle perçue du personnel enseignant Teacher training in Guatemala is characterized by a fragmented approach that neglects key elements such as emotional intelligence and the anthropological dimension of education. This study evaluates the impact of a targeted professional development program aimed at strengthening these competencies. A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design without a control group was applied with 63 teachers. The TMMS-24 scale was used to assess changes in emotional attention, clarity, and repair. Findings indicate statistically significant improvements, particularly among female participants, while the effects were more limited among male and administrative staff, likely due to smaller subgroup sizes. The results underscore the importance of integrating socioemotional and anthropological components into teacher education to promote emotional self-regulation and critical reflection. These skills are fundamental to a transformative teaching practice. Replicating this model in

title: Estado del conocimiento sobre la evaluación de la ética profesional docente en la universidad (2010-2024) Evaluation of Professional Ethics in University Teaching: A Thematic Review (2010-2024) Évaluation de l'Éthique Professionnelle dans l'Enseignement Universitaire : Une Revue Thématique (2010-2024) Avaliação da Ética Profissional na Docência Universitária: Uma Revisão Temática (2010-2024)
text_snippet: Estado del conocimiento sobre la evaluación de la ética profesional docente en la universidad (2010-2024) Evaluation of Professional Ethics in University Teaching: A Thematic Review (2010-2024) Évaluation de l'Éthique Professionnelle dans l'Enseignement Universitaire : Une Revue Thématique (2010-2024) Avaliação da Ética Profissional na Docência Universitária: Uma Revisão Temática (2010-2024) The work focuses on the evaluation of professional ethics as an assessable dimension within the framework of university teaching over more than a decade (2010-2024). Ninety-three studies that analyze professional ethics in terms of attitudinal traits associated with teaching behavior were reviewed. Methodologically, this is documentary research with an interpretive approach that followed a thematic analysis. The results are presented in four categories, of which the highest demonstrates the effort to define those competencies that best characterize professional ethics in university teachers. Conversely, the category on formative assessment reported the lowest number of studies. It is concluded by noting that the evaluation of professional ethics is still a debatable issue in higher education, requiring a rethinking of the meaning of evaluation that points toward a redefinition of teaching as a human and social profession.

title: Entre la ciencia y la desinformación: la percepción de profesores de ciencias sobre las fake news durante la pandemia de Covid-19 Between Science and Misinformation: Science Teachers' Perception of Fake News during the Covid-19 Pandemic Entre a Ciência e a Desinformação: A Percepção de Professores de Ciências sobre as Fake News durante a Pandemia de Covid-19 Entre la science et la désinformation : La perception des enseignants de sciences sur les fausses nouvelles pendant la pandémie de Covid-19
text_snippet: Entre la ciencia y la desinformación: la percepción de profesores de ciencias sobre las fake news durante la pandemia de Covid-19 Between Science and Misinformation: Science Teachers' Perception of Fake News during the Covid-19 Pandemic Entre a Ciência e a Desinformação: A Percepção de Professores de Ciências sobre as Fake News durante a Pandemia de Covid-19 Entre la science et la désinformation : La perception des enseignants de sciences sur les fausses nouvelles pendant la pandémie de Covid-19 La pandemia por Covid-19 intensificó la desinformación científica, lo que afectó también a docentes. Este estudio analizó la percepción de 52 profesores de Ciencias de Formiga - Minas Gerais (Brasil) y localidades circundantes sobre tres fake news frecuentes: origen del virus en laboratorio, ocultación de tratamientos eficaces e inseguridad de las vacunas. A través de un cuestionario en línea, se identificó que, aunque la mayoría rechazó las afirmaciones, entre 25% y 31% se mostraron indecisos, evidenciando vacilación epistémica. Además, 73.5% usaba redes sociales como principal fuente de información, frente a un escaso 5.8% que recurría a artículos científicos. El estudio concluye que es urgente fortalecer la formación docente como foco en el alfabetismo científico y mediático, así como en el pensamiento crítico y el enfrentamiento activo de la desinformación.

title: Dificultades de los estudiantes de Ingeniería en el primer año universitario Difficulties of Engineering Students in Their First Year of College Difficultés des Étudiants en Génie durant la Première Année Universitaire Dificuldades dos Estudantes de Engenharia no Primeiro Ano Universitário
text_snippet: Dificultades de los estudiantes de Ingeniería en el primer año universitario Difficulties of Engineering Students in Their First Year of College Difficultés des Étudiants en Génie durant la Première Année Universitaire Dificuldades dos Estudantes de Engenharia no Primeiro Ano Universitário This article addresses the difficulties perceived by first-year engineering students at the Autonomous University of Mexico City. Through qualitative and quantitative empirical research, factors related to dropout and academic failure were analyzed, and academic difficulties were identified and ranked using the concept of cultural capital. Additionally, students' strategies for overcoming these obstacles and their study habits were examined. This research corroborates the convergence of conditions that limit exclusive academic dedication and insufficient educational preparation marked by a deficit in critical academic skills and habits, coexisting with obstacles related to ineffective teaching practices. The findings suggest the absence of a comprehensive institutional classroom-centered strategy; therefore, this research can contribute to designing interventions that promote academic success.

title: ¿Qué significa ser docente para futuros maestros? Exploración desde estudiantes de escuelas normales mexicanas What Does It Mean to Be a Teacher for Future Educators? text_snippet: ¿Qué significa ser docente para futuros maestros? Exploración desde estudiantes de escuelas normales mexicanas What Does It Mean to Be a Teacher for Future Educators? An Exploration from Mexican Normal School Students Que signifie être enseignant pour les futurs maîtres ? Exploration à partir d'étudiants d'écoles normales mexicaines O que significa ser docente para futuros professores? Exploração a partir de estudantes de escolas normais mexicanas This article presents part of the results of a broader research project "Comparative Study on Initial Teacher Training in Basic Education in Mexico and France," coordinated by Ducoing and Pérez-Roux (2020). For this publication, the focus has been on exploring a central question: what does being a teacher mean for future teachers in training at Mexican normal schools? Based on a common questionnaire administered online and semi-structured interviews with normal school students who pursued different degree programs in various states under the 2018 curriculum, the question seeks to explore the construction of corporate ethos and professional habitus. Among the results obtained, meanings linked to the transmission of disciplinary knowledge stand out, and to a lesser extent, the construction of the student as a person and the pleasure of learning under professional orientations centered on didactics and the classroom.

title: Identidad profesional docente. Un acercamiento desde la perspectiva de profesores en formación Teacher Professional Identity: An Approach from the Perspective of Pre-Service Teachers Identité professionnelle enseignante : Une approche du point de vue des enseignants en formation Identidade Profissional Docente: Uma Aproximação desde a Perspectiva de Professores em Formação
text_snippet: Identidad profesional docente. Un acercamiento desde la perspectiva de profesores en formación Teacher Professional Identity: An Approach from the Perspective of Pre-Service Teachers Identité professionnelle enseignante : Une approche du point de vue des enseignants en formation Identidade Profissional Docente: Uma Aproximação desde a Perspectiva de Professores em Formação The focus of this study centers on investigating the identity of future teachers during their initial training at the Normal School and the aspects that influence its construction. Therefore, the design of this qualitative research corresponded to a phenomenological perspective. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with 16 students—from the fourth and eighth semesters—of the bachelor's degree in elementary education at a Normal School in Mexico. The results indicate that the biographical dimension of professional identity is relevant because through it, normalistas integrate new ideas about teaching as a profession. During initial training, and especially in professional practices, this construct evolves significantly. Thus, it is understood that future teachers gradually integrate work-related aspects of teaching into their professional identity and increasingly complex ideas about the teacher's work.

title: Impacto del uso de la inteligencia artificial en la educación superior Impact of Artificial Intelligence Use in Higher Education Impacto do uso da inteligência artificial na educação superior Impact de l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle dans l'enseignement supérieur
text_snippet: Impacto del uso de la inteligencia artificial en la educación superior Impact of Artificial Intelligence Use in Higher Education Impacto do uso da inteligência artificial na educação superior Impact de l'utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle dans l'enseignement supérieur The objective of this study was to analyze the impact of generative artificial intelligence (GAI), the perceptions, benefits, and limitations that higher education students present, through a mixed approach with descriptive-correlational, experimental, cross-sectional, and exploratory design, applying interviews, questionnaires, observation, and documentary analysis to a sample of 62 students. The results reveal that 71% use GAI to expedite information searches and resolve doubts, highlighting its usefulness for generating personalized content. Among the limitations are the possibility of technological dependence and the risk of receiving erroneous or copyrighted information. The study provides academic value by offering evidence about the responsible use of GAI in educational environments. It is concluded that, despite its benefits, it is necessary to implement training strategies for ethical and critical use of this technology in university education.

title: Políticas de estandarización chilena: Entre la subjetividad normada y performática del profesorado en formación inicial Chilean Standardization Policies: Between the Normed and Performative Subjectivity of Pre-service Teachers Politiques de normalisation chiliennes : Entre la subjectivité normée et performative du corps enseignant en formation initiale Políticas de padronização chilena: Entre a subjetividade normada e performática do professorado em formação inicial
text_snippet: Políticas de estandarización chilena: Entre la subjetividad normada y performática del profesorado en formación inicial Chilean Standardization Policies: Between the Normed and Performative Subjectivity of Pre-service Teachers Politiques de normalisation chiliennes : Entre la subjectivité normée et performative du corps enseignant en formation initiale Políticas de padronização chilena: Entre a subjetividade normada e performática do professorado em formação inicial Currently, it is possible to observe the proliferation of policies focused on improving teacher education and measuring their performance. In this context, the study's objective was to understand how preservice teachers construct their professional subjectivity based on interactions with normative discourses and institutional expectations derived from standardization policies in the Chilean university context. The methodological approach was qualitative, employing an instrumental case study with 19 education students. Among the findings, it is possible to highlight the university's role as a device for symbolic mediation and regulation, capable of intervening in teacher identity, which is configured under a regulated and performative subjectivity, given that future teachers prioritize behaviors aligned with compliance to external demands at the expense of an authentic and contextualized professional practice.
